patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: Started as a head cold off my grandson, and now I'm on that inhaler every hour and it's doing nothing at all. My test said it wasn't COVID.
clinical.presentationShort: 71yo M, COPD — 4 days coryza, now worsening dyspnoea and wheeze unresponsive to inhaler. RSV-positive contact.
clinical.presentationLong: 71-year-old male with COPD, four days of coryza and now worsening breathlessness and wheeze unresponsive to his own inhaler.

diagnosis.primary: RSV infection precipitating a COPD exacerbation
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → nebulisers, steroids, chest X-ray, blood gas; admission likely
diagnosis.why: RSV is badly underrated in older adults; in COPD it behaves like a serious exacerbation. And a negative COVID test says precisely nothing about it.
diagnosis.redFlag: SpO₂ 90% in an exacerbation not responding to his own inhaler — this one is heading toward non-invasive ventilation.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 71-year-old man in a zip-up cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair with an inhaler in his hand
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, shoulders hitched up with each breath
signs: an inhaler gripped in one hand
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: clearly short of breath but still talking in sentences
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 71-year-old man in a zip-up cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair with an inhaler in his hand. Pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, shoulders hitched up with each breath. Expression: tired and frustrated, jaw set. Clearly visible: pursed-lip breathing; raised hunched shoulders; an inhaler gripped in one hand. Overall: clearly short of breath but still talking in sentences. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
